description_en: Revokes model card licenses for consumers
name: RevokeConsumerModelCardGrants

parameters.help_en: The immutable ID of the new model API. The authorization is valid only within this API
parameters.help_zh: 新版 Model API 的不可变ID，授权仅在此 API 内有效
parameters.name: http_api_id

parameters.help_en: The collection of model card IDs to be revoked within this API. Revoking a non-existent license is a valid no-op
parameters.help_zh: 此 API 内撤销的模型卡片ID集合。撤销不存在的许可是合法的空操作
parameters.name: model_card_ids

parameters.help_en: The collection of actual model group IDs to be revoked within this API. When revoking only group licenses, modelCardIds can be empty, and the group or principal is not required to exist. At least one of the two target types must be non-empty. This operation does not delete consumers, keys, or quotas
parameters.help_zh: 本API内撤销的真实模型组ID；仅撤销组许可时modelCardIds可空，不要求组或主体仍存在。两类目标至少一项非空，不删除消费者、Key或额度
parameters.name: model_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The immutable ID of the principal for which the license is revoked. This is not the name
parameters.help_zh: 撤销主体的不可变ID（不是名称）
parameters.name: principal_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the principal for which the license is revoked. Valid values: Consumer and ConsumerGroup
parameters.help_zh: 撤销主体类型。取值包括 Consumer、ConsumerGroup
parameters.name: principal_type

code.description_en: The response status code. A value of Ok indicates success, and a specific business error code indicates failure
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the consumer operation
data.description_zh: 消费者操作返回的业务结果

changedCount.description_en: The number of license rows actually revoked in this operation. A value of 0 indicates an idempotent operation with no changes
changedCount.description_zh: 本次实际撤销的许可行数，0表示幂等无变化
changedCount.title_en: 本次实际撤销的许可行数，0表示幂等无变化。
changedCount.title_zh: 本次实际撤销的许可行数，0表示幂等无变化。

entitlementState.description_en: The projection state of the model license in the gateway domain
entitlementState.description_zh: 网关域模型许可投影状态

errorMessage.description_en: The error message when the projection fails
errorMessage.description_zh: 投影失败时的错误信息
errorMessage.title_en: 投影失败时的错误信息。
errorMessage.title_zh: 投影失败时的错误信息。

entitlementState.title_en: 网关域模型许可投影状态。
entitlementState.title_zh: 网关域模型许可投影状态。

message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果
